hook.line: "This is the exact process I would follow" to rank a brand new website on Google.
hook.visual: Selfie close-up at home, pointing at camera; red sparkle banner 'SEO method for beginners' plus a white 'Step by step' tag, words build up mid-frame.

beats.what: Face to camera promises her exact step-by-step process for a new site.
Cut to an iPad with handwritten notes titled 'SEO STRATEGY'; voice continues over it.
Step 1 keyword research: Apple Pencil points at the handwritten bullet list as she reads it.
Cut to a scrolled view: step 2 on-page optimisation, key items highlighted in green.
Step 3 technical SEO: redirects, sitemap, page speed.
Scroll down to step 4 link building, marked with an orange 'repeat' dot for ongoing tasks.
Step 5 topical authority: blog posts, guides, resources.
Notes zoomed out to show the whole plan on one page at the end.

why_it_works: The handwritten numbered plan works as a progress bar: the viewer sees steps 1-5 coming and stays to the end of the list.
The pencil tip points at each line as it is spoken, so the eye always knows where to look without any edited graphics.
The full one-page plan at the end is screenshot-worthy, which fits the 1,513 shares.
Face only for the first 4.8 s (face share 5%) buys trust, then hands over to the content.
weaknesses: Only 2 cuts in 96 s; the long 74.6 s notes shot leans on slow scrolling alone.
Captions sit mid-frame over the handwriting and cover the notes they describe.
No call to action at the end; the caption asks for comments but the video does not.
for_robert: Use a hand-drawn numbered checklist that Fred taps or points at line by line as Robert names each step, so the list itself shows progress.
